payload.detail: NEW INFORMATION 2026-10-13: on PR 3507 the PR required check reported failure on three commits whose CI runs were cancelled by a newer push (or a merge of main) while still running, with every real job passing or cancelled and none failed. A cancelled run is therefore shown as a red PR required, which can look like the unexplained failures this row tracks. Next: when it recurs, check whether the run was cancelled by a newer head SHA before treating it as a real failure; consider making PR required report cancelled instead of failure.
